title: Pages in a Sketchbook
story: Hana draws in a sketchbook every Sunday. This week she sat in the park and drew the stone bridge. A child asked if he could watch, and Hana nodded. She showed him how to hold the pencil lightly. The child drew a duck and grinned. Hana gave him a spare page to take home. She stayed until the light faded and then closed the book.
